dct_title_s: Indonesia Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps, Jan 2023
dct_description_sm: # Indonesia Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps, Jan 2023 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Indonesia Earthquake (Jan 2023) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Earthquake, 10 Jan 2023, v0.9 wbd** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Earthquake, 10 Jan 2023, v0.9 wbd** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Earthquake, 10 Jan 2023, v0.9 ** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Earthquake, 10 Jan 2023, v0.9 ** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA), NASA-JPL/Caltech, Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2022-2023)
